preconditions.description: V is a positive integer representing the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: isinstance(adj, list) and len(adj) == V and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: adj is a list of length V where each element is a list of neighbors (adjacency list).

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= v < V for v in neighbors) for neighbors in adj)
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the adjacency list are within the valid range [0, V-1].

preconditions.expression: all((u in adj[v]) == (v in adj[u]) for u in range(V) for v in adj[u])
preconditions.description: The graph is undirected; if u is in v's adjacency list, v must be in u's adjacency list.

postconditions.description: The function returns an integer 0, 1, or 2.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 2 if (all(len(adj[v]) % 2 == 0 for v in range(V)) and any(len(adj[v]) > 0 for v in range(V))) else (return_value == 1 if (sum(1 for v in range(V) if len(adj[v]) % 2 != 0) == 2 and any(len(adj[v]) > 0 for v in range(V))) else return_value == 0)
postconditions.description: Returns 2 if the graph has an Eulerian Circuit (all vertices have even degree and at least one edge exists), 1 if it has an Eulerian Path (exactly two vertices have odd degree and at least one edge exists), and 0 otherwise.
